title: 10. Validate a body before building success

examples.explanation: A valid body. `note` is missing, so it is `null`.
Four errors: an uppercase account, an amount of 0, a note that is not a string, and the unknown key `extra`.
The body is not an object, so the response is 400.

hints: Check body shape before reading fields.
Use type(value) is int to exclude booleans.
